description.value: Senor Duggies Tacos & Pizzeria is the only Mexican restaurant within 200 kilometres in the Fraser Lake area of central BC, serving tacos, burritos, enchiladas, and chimichangas alongside pizza, burgers, fish and chips, and coconut shrimp. Reviewers passing through on road trips consistently praise the food and friendly atmosphere, and the restaurant also offers margaritas and tequilas. For a touring cyclist on the remote Highway 16 corridor between Prince George and Burns Lake, this is a rare full-service dining stop in a very sparse stretch of interior BC.

address.value: 324 McMillan Ave, Fraser Lake, BC V0J 1S0
